data_description.ai_task_entity: Choose a configured AI Task provider or leave blank to use Home Assistant's preferred provider.
data_description.discovery_interval_hours: The Observer collects only change counts between reviews, then asks the AI to reevaluate the useful device and entity set.
data_description.learning_only: When enabled, observations and summaries are stored but anomaly notifications are suppressed.
data_description.lookback_hours: How much recent activity is included in each scheduled summary.
data_description.minimum_baseline_samples: An entity must have this many observations before it can produce a numeric deviation candidate.
data_description.notify_daily_summary: Requires a notification action below. This setting is independent of anomaly alerts.
data_description.notify_service: Enter the full Home Assistant action name. Leave blank to keep summaries inside Home Assistant only.
data_description.observer_guidance: Property-specific priorities included with every AI summary. Edit this text at any time, or clear it to remove the guidance.
data_description.retention_days: Raw curated observations older than this are discarded. Learned aggregate baselines remain.
data_description.summary_time: Uses Home Assistant's configured local time zone.
data_description.zscore_threshold: Higher values create fewer deviation candidates. The default is deliberately conservative.

behavior.description: Start conservatively. Learning-only mode is recommended until the observer has seen several stays.
behavior.title: Observer behavior

data_description.always_monitor_devices: User override: eligible entities from these devices are monitored even if the AI does not recommend them.
data_description.always_monitor_entities: User override: these individual entities are monitored even if the AI does not recommend them.
data_description.auto_discovery: Review eligible entities by room and device, learn how often they change, and let the configured AI choose a minimal useful set.
data_description.access_entities: Door contacts, exterior locks, and related access indicators.
data_description.activity_entities: Motion, presence, appliance use, or other indicators of household activity.
data_description.energy_entities: Whole-home and important circuit power sensors, including Emporia entities.
data_description.hvac_entities: Thermostats, mini-splits, temperature sensors, and HVAC operating states.
data_description.network_entities: Starlink connectivity, latency, throughput, and router availability.
data_description.never_monitor_devices: User override: entities belonging to these devices are never monitored. This override always wins.
data_description.never_monitor_entities: User override: these individual entities are never monitored. This override always wins.
data_description.occupancy_entities: Non-camera occupancy estimates or presence helpers.
data_description.reservation_entities: Calendar or helper entities that describe the current stay.
data_description.spa_entities: Gecko water temperature, setpoint, heater, pump, filter, ozone, and spa power entities.

entities.description: Leave the manual categories blank to let automatic discovery choose. Always and never overrides take precedence over AI recommendations.
entities.title: Choose entities

data_description.property_name: The name used in summaries, notifications, and the observer device.

user.description: House Observer turns selected Home Assistant telemetry into bounded local memory, operational summaries, and explainable anomaly candidates.
user.title: Set up House Observer

data_description.always_monitor_devices: User override: eligible entities from these devices are always monitored.
data_description.always_monitor_entities: User override: these entities are always monitored.
data_description.auto_discovery: When enabled, AI recommendations are reevaluated on the configured interval.
data_description.discovery_interval_hours: Change counts are kept locally between reviews. The default is once per week.
data_description.learning_only: Disable only after reviewing several summaries and learned behavior.
data_description.never_monitor_devices: User override: entities belonging to these devices are never monitored. This always wins.
data_description.never_monitor_entities: User override: these entities are never monitored. This always wins.
data_description.notify_service: Use a full action name such as notify.mobile_app_phone.
data_description.observer_guidance: This guidance is included with every AI summary. Edit it here or clear the field to remove it.

discover_entities.description: Inventory eligible entities by area and ask the AI provider to choose a minimal useful monitoring set.
discover_entities.name: Discover important devices

generate_summary.description: Generate and store an operational summary now.
generate_summary.name: Generate summary

record_note.description: Add an owner or maintenance note to local observer memory.
record_note.name: Record note

set_stay_context.description: Set or clear reservation context for the current stay.
set_stay_context.name: Set stay context
